title: Reviewed budget history
responsibility: Combines repeated ledger events into review histories and selects the reviewed limits relevant to a unit’s source and emitted targets.

inputs.name: budgetReviews.ledgers
inputs.description: Budget ledgers from one or more revisions; identical events are deduplicated by canonical JSON.

inputs.name: frozenLimits.baseline
inputs.description: Reviewed baseline containing frozen metrics and optional unavailable reasons, or undefined when none exists.

inputs.name: emittedLimits.unit
inputs.description: Unit manifest whose execution targets determine which emitted limits are relevant.

inputs.name: emittedLimits.baseline
inputs.description: Reviewed baseline to read target-specific limits and unavailable reasons from; may be undefined.

outputs.name: budgetReviews
outputs.description: Map from unit id to unique reviews sorted by their at timestamp, including the measured commit, reviewer, reason and before/after limits.

outputs.name: frozenLimits
outputs.description: Only source-bytes, complexity and dependencies limits and their unavailable reasons; undefined when the baseline is absent.

outputs.name: emittedLimits
outputs.description: Limits and unavailable reasons keyed by emitted runtime kind; undefined when the unit emits nothing, and an empty limits map when targets exist without reviewed limits.
